title: AggregateReadyPayload
description: Payload of the AggregateReady event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8; class: domain). Authored by INV-T-2853 (T9). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

entityRef.description: The registered entity the aggregate belongs to.

periodRef.description: Prescribed period reference, when the window is period-aligned.

linesByInternalTaxCode.description: Aggregated lines, one per internal tax code.

internalTaxCode.description: The internal tax code this line aggregates.

amount.description: Aggregated amount for this tax code. Decimal string (API-12 convention).

underlyingRef.description: References to the underlying records this aggregate was built from.
